name: done-proof-fails
about: Done proofs (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-done-proofs.md), a done item's check failing. a merged straight to done; the done sweep's proof is one command that fails on main. The first proof pass records the failure and says nothing (a flaky check files no work); 30 minutes later it fails again: the loop files a P1 item with the failure as its ask, linked by reopen_of, and a stays done, its status failed; a's thread says what failed and which item fixes it. The board's Done column shows a as failed with the item filed.

proof.run: test -f chime.wav || { echo 'chime.wav is not on main'; exit 1; }

data.words: ^Proof of the merged change failed 2 times in a row: command: `test -f chime\.wav .*`: exit 1 after 0s: chime\.wav is not on main$

messages.text: ^Proof of the merged change failed 2 times in a row: .*chime\.wav is not on main\. Filed #2 .*\(P1\) to fix it; this one stays done\.$
